verdict.rationale: Qapita is a cap table platform, so a change audit log is a fair question to ask of it. The pack never documents one. The "audit-ready" wording refers to valuations and financial reports, which is a different feature from a log of who changed the cap table, what, when and under what authorization. The "single source of truth" claim does not describe change tracking either.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
